import html # Predefined template for formatting blog posts. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def publish_blog_article(subject: str, description: str) -> str: """ Render a user‑submitted blog post safely. Parameters ---------- subject : str The heading of the blog post. description : str The main text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized and formatted HTML snippet ready for display. Raises ------ ValueError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(subject, str) or not isinstance(description, str): raise ValueError("Both subject and description must be strings.") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS attacks. safe_title = html.escape(subject, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Format the blog post using the predefined template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
